subtitle: Cases of burning, beheading, and strangulation
author: Moses Maimonides
intro: Rambam's Commentary on the Mishnah in the original 12th-century Judeo-Arabic. Hover a phrase to see its English light up; tap any word for a dictionary gloss.

aligned.ja: כד'לך ואנהמא מת'ל סאיר אלעבירות למעני אלהצלה, וכתב אללה רוצח וזכר למעוטי בהמה ועבודה זרה ושבת כמא ד'כרנא.
aligned.en: Likewise these two — and they are like the other transgressions with respect to the principle of rescue — and Scripture wrote "murderer" and made mention [of these cases] in order to exclude an animal, idolatry, and the Sabbath, as we have noted.

pairs.en: like the other transgressions
the principle of rescue
Scripture wrote "murderer"
in order to exclude an animal, idolatry, and the Sabbath

aligned.ja: ומעני הד'ה אלהצלה אנה פרץ' עלינא אן נכ'לץ הד'א אלשכ'ץ אלמתבוע מן יד אלתאבע אלד'י יטלב אן יקתלה או יעבור בו עבירה באי וג'ה אמכן ולו בקתל אלרודף ועלי אנה לם יד'נב בעד.
aligned.en: The meaning of this rescue is that it is an obligation imposed upon us to deliver this pursued person from the hand of the pursuer who seeks to kill him or to make him commit a transgression with him, by any means possible, even by killing the pursuer, and even though the pursuer has not yet committed the offense.

pairs.en: The meaning of this rescue
an obligation imposed upon us
this pursued person
the hand of the pursuer
even by killing the pursuer
has not yet committed the offense

aligned.ja: והד'א הו מעני בנפשן, יעני בנפש הרודף.
aligned.en: This is the meaning of "[they may be saved] at the cost of their lives" — that is, at the cost of the life of the pursuer.

pairs.en: the meaning of "[they may be saved] at the cost of their lives"
at the cost of the life of the pursuer

aligned.ja: ומתי מא תעדי ועבר עבירה פלא יג'וז קתלה אלא בבית דין ועדים ועלי אלוג'וה אלתי תקדם שרחהא.
aligned.en: But once [the offender] has acted and committed the transgression, it is not permitted to kill him except by a court and witnesses, and according to the procedures whose explanation has already been set out.

pairs.en: has acted and committed the transgression
it is not permitted to kill him
by a court and witnesses
whose explanation has already been set out

aligned.ja: וליס כד'לך מן ראינאה יתבע בהמה או ירום חלול שבת או עבודה זרה, בל לנא אן נמנעה ונעוקה בכל מא אמכן גיר קתלה פאנה לא יג'וז חתי יד'נב בעדים והתראה פיקתלה בית דין.
aligned.en: It is not so, however, with one whom we see pursuing an animal, or intending to profane the Sabbath, or [to commit] idolatry: here we are entitled to prevent him and to restrain him by every possible means short of killing him, for [killing him] is not permitted until he transgresses in the presence of witnesses and after due warning, whereupon the court may put him to death.

pairs.en: one whom we see pursuing an animal
intending to profane the Sabbath
to prevent him and to restrain him by every possible means
short of killing him
he transgresses in the presence of witnesses and after due warning
the court may put him to death

aligned.ja: וכד'לך סאיר אלעבירות מא סוי אלעריות ורוצח עלי מא בינא.
aligned.en: And so it is with the other transgressions apart from the forbidden sexual unions and murder, in accordance with what we have explained.

pairs.en: the other transgressions
the forbidden sexual unions and murder

aligned.ja: משנה [א]
aligned.en: Mishnah 1

aligned.ja: שיסה בו, הו אן ישיר עלי ד'לך אלחיואן באליד או באלצות ויסלטה עליה.
aligned.en: *"If he set [an animal] upon him"* — this means that he incited that animal against the man by hand or by voice and let it loose upon him.

pairs.en: "If he set [an animal] upon him"
he incited that animal against the man
by hand or by voice
let it loose upon him

aligned.ja: והשיך, אן יפתח פם ד'לך אלחיואן וילזק אסנאנה פי ג'סמה.
aligned.en: *"And he made it bite"* — that he opened the mouth of that animal and fixed its teeth into his body.

pairs.en: "And he made it bite"
he opened the mouth of that animal
fixed its teeth into his body

aligned.ja: והלכה כחכמים פי אלכל.
aligned.en: The law is in accordance with the Sages in all of this.

pairs.en: The law is in accordance with the Sages

aligned.ja: משנה [ב]
aligned.en: Mishnah 2

aligned.ja: כ'לאף ר' שמעון אנמא הו עלי נתיג'הֵ אלפצל אלאול והו קולה נתכוון להרוג את הבהמה והרג את האדם פטור, נתיג'הֵ ד'לך אנה אד'א נתכוון להכות אדם והכה אדם אחר חייב.
aligned.en: The dissent of R. Shimon bears only upon the inference drawn from the first clause, namely the statement, "If he intended to kill the animal and killed the man, he is exempt." The inference from this is that if he intended to strike one person and struck another person, he is liable.

pairs.en: The dissent of R. Shimon
the inference drawn from the first clause

pairs.ja: נתכוון להכות אדם והכה אדם אחר חייב
pairs.en: he intended to strike one person and struck another person, he is liable

aligned.ja: פכ'אלף ר' שמעון עלי ד'לך וקאל אפילו נתכוון להרוג את זה והרג את זה פטור.
aligned.en: R. Shimon dissented on this point and said: even if he intended to kill this one and killed that one, he is exempt.

pairs.en: R. Shimon dissented on this point

pairs.ja: אפילו נתכוון להרוג את זה והרג את זה פטור
pairs.en: even if he intended to kill this one and killed that one, he is exempt

aligned.ja: והלכה כר' שמעון.
aligned.en: The law is in accordance with R. Shimon.

pairs.en: The law is in accordance with R. Shimon

aligned.ja: משנה [ג]
aligned.en: Mishnah 3

aligned.ja: כלאם ר' יהודה אנמא הו עלי כלאם מצ'מר, וד'לך אן חץ או אבן שיצא מבין אנשים הרבה והרג ולם יעלם מן רמאה כולם פטורים וליס פי הד'א כ'לאף.
aligned.en: The statement of R. Yehudah bears only upon an implied premise. That premise is: if a pebble or a stone went out from among many people and killed [someone], and it is not known who threw it, all of them are exempt — and in this there is no dispute.

pairs.en: The statement of R. Yehudah
an implied premise

pairs.ja: חץ או אבן שיצא מבין אנשים הרבה
pairs.en: a pebble or a stone went out from among many people

pairs.ja: לם יעלם מן רמאה כולם פטורים
pairs.en: it is not known who threw it, all of them are exempt

aligned.ja: אמא שור שהרג ונגמר דינו ונתערב בשוורים אחרים סוקלין את כולם, ור' יהודה יכ'אלף פי הד'א אלפצל ויקול כונסין אותן לכיפה.
aligned.en: But [as for] an ox that killed and whose case was concluded [for execution] and that then became mixed in with other oxen, they stone all of them; and R. Yehudah dissents in this clause and says, they confine them in a vaulted cell.

pairs.en: an ox that killed and whose case was concluded [for execution]
became mixed in with other oxen
they stone all of them

pairs.ja: ר' יהודה יכ'אלף פי הד'א אלפצל
pairs.en: R. Yehudah dissents in this clause
they confine them in a vaulted cell

aligned.ja: ואין הלכה כר' יהודה. ולא כר' שמעון.
aligned.en: The law is neither in accordance with R. Yehudah nor with R. Shimon.

pairs.en: neither in accordance with R. Yehudah
nor with R. Shimon

aligned.ja: משנה [ד]
aligned.en: Mishnah 4

aligned.ja: כלאמה אלאול פי שכ'ץ עבר עבירה ונגמר דינו למיתה קלה, ובעד ד'לך עבר עבירה חמורה, כאן יקום באלבאל אנה נדון בקלה לאנה גברא קטילא ולא ילתפת למא פעל בעד ד'לך, פאעלמנא אנה נדון בחמורה.
aligned.en: His first statement concerns a person who committed a transgression and whose case was concluded for a lighter mode of execution, and who afterward committed a transgression carrying a graver mode of execution. One might have supposed that he should be judged by the lighter mode, since he is [already] a condemned man, and no regard need be paid to what he did afterward; so [the Mishnah] informs us that he is judged by the graver mode.

pairs.en: whose case was concluded for a lighter mode of execution
committed a transgression carrying a graver mode of execution
a condemned man

pairs.ja: לא ילתפת למא פעל בעד ד'לך
pairs.en: no regard need be paid to what he did afterward
he is judged by the graver mode

aligned.ja: וצפהֵ זיקה ראשונה עלי מא אצף, מת'ל אן תכון חמותו אשת אביו ויבוא עליה, מן חית' הי חמותו ילזמה שריפה, ומן חית' הי אשת אביו ילזמה סקילה.
aligned.en: The description of the "first attachment" is as I shall set out: for example, that his mother-in-law was [also] his father's wife and he had relations with her — inasmuch as she is his mother-in-law he incurs burning, and inasmuch as she is his father's wife he incurs stoning.

pairs.en: "first attachment"
his mother-in-law was [also] his father's wife

pairs.ja: מן חית' הי חמותו ילזמה שריפה
pairs.en: inasmuch as she is his mother-in-law he incurs burning

pairs.ja: מן חית' הי אשת אביו ילזמה סקילה
pairs.en: inasmuch as she is his father's wife he incurs stoning

aligned.ja: פאן כאן צארת חמותו קבל אן יזוג'הא אביה ידון בשריפה, ואן כאן אבוה אזוג'הא אולא ובעד חצולהא אשת אביו אזוג' בנתהא וצארת חמותו ידון בסקילה, ועלי הד'א פקס.
aligned.en: If she became his mother-in-law before her father married her [to his own father], he is judged by burning; but if his father married her first, and after she had become his father's wife [his father] married her daughter [to him] so that she became his mother-in-law, he is judged by stoning. Reckon the rest by this.

pairs.ja: צארת חמותו קבל אן יזוג'הא אביה
pairs.en: she became his mother-in-law before her father married her
he is judged by burning
his father married her first
he is judged by stoning
Reckon the rest by this

aligned.ja: ואין הלכה כר' יוסי.
aligned.en: The law is not in accordance with R. Yose.

pairs.en: The law is not in accordance with R. Yose

aligned.ja: משנה [ה]
aligned.en: Mishnah 5

aligned.ja: כיפה, מטבק יעמל פי אלסג'ון יכון ארתפאעה מת'ל קאמת אלשכ'ץ סוי ולא יכון מעה פיה חית' ימתד ולא ינאם.
aligned.en: *"The vaulted cell"* (*kippah*) — a vault constructed within prisons, whose height is exactly the stature of the man, so that he has no room within it to stretch out or to lie down.

pairs.en: a vault constructed within prisons
whose height is exactly the stature of the man

pairs.ja: לא יכון מעה פיה חית' ימתד ולא ינאם
pairs.en: he has no room within it to stretch out or to lie down

aligned.ja: והד'א אלד'י קלנא הנא לקה ושנה, מלקות של כרת ופי ד'לך אלד'נב בעינה מת'ל אכל אלחלב מרה בעד מרה, אמא כרתות מכ'תלפה פלא.
aligned.en: This of which we have spoken here [applies where] he was flogged and repeated [the offense] — [a case of] the flogging [incurred] for *karet*, and in that very same offense, such as eating forbidden fat time after time; but not [for] distinct [offenses each carrying] *karet*.

pairs.en: he was flogged and repeated [the offense]
the flogging [incurred] for *karet*
eating forbidden fat time after time
distinct [offenses each carrying] *karet*

aligned.ja: לאן כל מחוייב כרת פקט יצ'רב מלקות וקד ד'כרנא ד'לך וסיבין אצלה פי מא בעד.
aligned.en: For everyone who incurs *karet* alone is given lashes, as we have already mentioned, and we shall set out its basis further on.

pairs.en: everyone who incurs *karet* alone
is given lashes
we shall set out its basis further on

aligned.ja: אמא מלקות דלאו פהו יצ'רב מתי מא עצי ויטלק ולו אלף מרה.
aligned.en: As for the lashes [incurred] for a [mere] negative commandment, he is flogged each time he disobeys and is then released, even a thousand times.

pairs.en: the lashes [incurred] for a [mere] negative commandment
he is flogged each time he disobeys and is then released
even a thousand times

aligned.ja: וקולה שלא בעדים, יריד בה שלא בעדות שחייב בה מיתה והו אן לא תסתקל אלשהאדה בוג'ה מן אלוג'וה אלתי תמנע אלקתל בתלך אלשהאדה ואן כאנת חק, מת'ל פסאד אלהתראה, או שכוך וקעת פי אלבדיקות ואלחקירות ונחו ד'לך.
aligned.en: His statement *"not through [the requisite] witnesses"* means: not through testimony by which he would incur the death penalty — that is, that the testimony should not stand up, by reason of any of the factors that nullify execution on the basis of that testimony even when it is true, such as a flaw in the warning, or doubts that arose in the examinations and interrogations, and the like.

pairs.en: "not through [the requisite] witnesses"
not through testimony by which he would incur the death penalty
a flaw in the warning
the examinations and interrogations

aligned.ja: וכל מן יסתחק אלכיפה נותנין לו לחם צר ומים לחץ חתי תצ'עף קואה וינסל ג'סמה ובעד ד'לך מאכילין אותו שעורים עד שכרסו נבקעת.
aligned.en: Everyone who is liable to the vaulted cell is given scant bread and meager water until his strength fails and his body wastes away, and afterward they feed him barley until his belly bursts.

pairs.en: Everyone who is liable to the vaulted cell

pairs.ja: נותנין לו לחם צר ומים לחץ
pairs.en: is given scant bread and meager water
his strength fails and his body wastes away

pairs.ja: מאכילין אותו שעורים עד שכרסו נבקעת
pairs.en: they feed him barley until his belly bursts

aligned.ja: משנה [ו]
aligned.en: Mishnah 6

aligned.ja: קסוה, כלי שרת, משתק מן קשות הנסך. והמקלל בקוסם, הו אן יברך השם בשם עבודה זרה.
aligned.en: *"The flagon"* (*kasvah*) — a service vessel, [the word being] derived from "the flagons (*qesavot*) of the libation" (Numbers 4:7). *"And one who curses by an enchanter's name"* — this means that he blesses the [Divine] Name by the name of an idolatrous deity.

pairs.en: derived from "the flagons (*qesavot*) of the libation"
"And one who curses by an enchanter's name"
he blesses the [Divine] Name by the name of an idolatrous deity

aligned.ja: ובועל ארמית, אן יבעול בת עובדי עבודה זרה בפרהסיא בעשרה ישראל פמא זאד ובשעת מעשה צ'רורה מת'ל קצ'יהֵ פינחס.
aligned.en: *"And one who has relations with an Aramean woman"* — that he has relations with the daughter of idolaters publicly, before ten Israelites or more, and at the very moment of the act, under duress [of circumstance], as in the affair of Pinchas (Numbers 25:7–8).

pairs.en: "And one who has relations with an Aramean woman"
the daughter of idolaters publicly
before ten Israelites or more
at the very moment of the act
the affair of Pinchas

aligned.ja: אמא בעד אנעזאלה, או אד'א לם יכן פי ג'מע ישראל, או כאנת גיר עובדת עבודה זרה פלא יג'וז קתלה.
aligned.en: But after he has separated [from her], or if it was not in an assembly of Israelites, or if she was not an idolatress, it is not permitted to kill him;

pairs.en: after he has separated [from her]
not in an assembly of Israelites
it is not permitted to kill him

aligned.ja: לכנה מחויב כרת על בת עובד עבודה זרה ואן כאן לם יד'כר פי אלתורה ולא עדד פי ג'מלה אלכרתות לכנה נקל ותבין פי אלמקרא פי קולה ובעל בת אל נכר יכרת ה' לאיש אשר יעשנה וכו'.
aligned.en: yet he is liable to *karet* for [relations with] the daughter of an idolater, even though this is not stated in the Torah nor counted among the [enumerated] instances of *karet* — rather it is transmitted [by tradition] and is made clear in Scripture, in the verse "and has married the daughter of a foreign god — may the Lord cut off (*yakhret*) the man who does this" (Malachi 2:11–12).

pairs.ja: מחויב כרת על בת עובד עבודה זרה
pairs.en: liable to *karet* for [relations with] the daughter of an idolater
not stated in the Torah
nor counted among the [enumerated] instances of *karet*
transmitted [by tradition] and is made clear in Scripture

pairs.ja: ובעל בת אל נכר יכרת ה' לאיש אשר יעשנה
pairs.en: "and has married the daughter of a foreign god — may the Lord cut off (*yakhret*) the man who does this"

aligned.ja: וקד בינוא איצ'א אן הבא על הגויה ילזמה מלקיות כת'ירה לכן כלהא מדרבנן.
aligned.en: They have further made clear that one who has relations with a gentile woman incurs numerous floggings, but all of them are by rabbinic ordinance.

pairs.en: one who has relations with a gentile woman
incurs numerous floggings
all of them are by rabbinic ordinance

aligned.ja: ואד'א סאלנא אלקנא הל יפגע בו אם לא ואן כאן בשעת מעשה פלא נפתיה, פאן בטש וקתלה לא עקאב עליה.
aligned.en: If the zealot asks us whether he may strike him down or not, then — even if it be at the very moment of the act — we do not [so] instruct him; yet if he assaulted and killed him, there is no penalty upon him.

pairs.en: the zealot
whether he may strike him down or not
we do not [so] instruct him
he assaulted and killed him, there is no penalty upon him

aligned.ja: וכד'לך אן קוי אלבועל וקתל אלקנא ליכ'לץ נפסה מן ידה לא ילזמה עליה קתל, לאנה רודף אחריו להרגו, ואלשריעה לם תבת אלחכם בקתלה אלא עלי אלוג'ה אלמוצוף.
aligned.en: Likewise, if the one having relations overpowered and killed the zealot in order to deliver himself from his hand, no [penalty of] death falls upon him, for [the zealot] is "pursuing him to kill him," and the Law established the ruling permitting his killing only in the manner described.

pairs.en: the one having relations overpowered and killed the zealot
in order to deliver himself from his hand
the Law established the ruling permitting his killing
only in the manner described

aligned.ja: וקאל אללה והזר הקרב יומת ר' עקיבה יקול מיתת חנק, ואלחכמים יקולון מיתה בידי שמים.
aligned.en: God said, "and the outsider who draws near shall be put to death" (Numbers 1:51): R. Akiva says, [this means] death by strangulation, while the Sages say, death at the hands of Heaven.

pairs.en: "and the outsider who draws near shall be put to death"
R. Akiva says, [this means] death by strangulation
the Sages say, death at the hands of Heaven

aligned.ja: והד'ה אלמיתה בידי שמים הי אקל מן אלכרת, לאן מחוייב כרת יבקי אלעקאב עליה בעד אלמות כמא נבין פי אלפרק אלד'י בעד הד'א, ומחוייב מיתה אד'א מאת גפר לה.
aligned.en: This death at the hands of Heaven is less [severe] than *karet*, for one liable to *karet* — the penalty remains upon him after death, as we shall explain in the chapter following this one, whereas one liable to [judicial] death, when he dies, is forgiven.

pairs.ja: מיתה בידי שמים הי אקל מן אלכרת
pairs.en: death at the hands of Heaven is less [severe] than *karet*

pairs.ja: מחוייב כרת יבקי אלעקאב עליה בעד אלמות
pairs.en: one liable to *karet* — the penalty remains upon him after death
the chapter following this one

pairs.ja: מחוייב מיתה אד'א מאת גפר לה
pairs.en: one liable to [judicial] death, when he dies, is forgiven

aligned.ja: והאולא אלמחוייבי מיתה איצ'א יצ'רבון מלקות דאוריתא אד'א צח אלד'נב בעדים והתראה מת'ל מחוייבי כרת סוי ובשרט אן יכון תעדיהם עלי לאו.
aligned.en: These persons liable to [judicial] death are likewise flogged by Torah law if the offense is established by witnesses and warning, exactly like those liable to *karet*, provided that their transgression be of a negative commandment.

pairs.en: persons liable to [judicial] death
flogged by Torah law
the offense is established by witnesses and warning
exactly like those liable to *karet*
their transgression be of a negative commandment

aligned.ja: ומחוייבי מיתה הם אוכל טבל, וכהן טמא שאכל תרומה טהורה, וזר שאכל תרומה, וזר ששמש, וטמא ששמש, וטבול יום ששמש, ומחוסר בגדים, ומחוסר כפורים, ושלא
aligned.en: Those liable to [judicial] death are: one who eats untithed produce (*tevel*); a priest who is ritually impure and ate ritually pure heave-offering (*terumah*); a non-priest who ate heave-offering; a non-priest who performed the [Temple] service; a [ritually] impure one who performed the service; one who immersed that day [but had not yet awaited nightfall] and performed the service; one lacking the [proper] vestments; one lacking [his required] atonement-offerings; and one who [served] without...

pairs.en: Those liable to [judicial] death are
